an4.243:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an4.243:1.2: athakho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an4.243:1.5: āyasmato bhante anuruddhassa vāhiyo nāma saddhivihāriko kevalakappaṃ saṃghabhedāya ṭhito
an4.243:1.6: tatthāyasmā anuruddho na ekavācikampi bhaṇitabbaṃ maññatīti.
an4.243:2.1: kadā panānanda anuruddho saṃghamajjhe adhikaraṇesu voyuñjati
an4.243:2.2: nanu ānanda yānikānici adhikaraṇāni uppajjanti sabbāni tāni tumhe ceva vūpasametha sāriputtamoggallānā ca
an4.243:3.1: cattārome ānanda atthavase sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṃghabhedena nandati
an4.243:3.3: idhānanda pāpabhikkhu dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asucisaṃkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño antoputi avassuto kasambujāto
an4.243:3.6: dussīlo pāpadhammo asucisaṃkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño antoputi avassuto kasambujātoti samaggā maṃ santā nāsessanti
an4.243:3.8: idaṃ ānanda paṭhamaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṃghabhedena nandati.
an4.243:4.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda pāpabhikkhu micchādiṭṭhiko hoti antaggāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato
an4.243:4.4: micchādiṭṭhiko antaggāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgatoti samaggā maṃ santā nāsessanti
an4.243:4.6: idaṃ ānanda dutiyaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṃghabhedena nandati.
an4.243:5.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda pāpabhikkhu micchāājīvo hoti micchāājīvena jīvitaṃ kappeti
an4.243:5.4: micchāājīvo micchāājīvena jīvitaṃ kappetīti samaggā maṃ santā nāsessanti
an4.243:5.6: idaṃ ānanda tatiyaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṃghabhedena nandati.
an4.243:6.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda pāpabhikkhu lābhakāmo hoti sakkārakāmo anavaññattikāmo
an4.243:6.4: lābhakāmo sakkārakāmo anavaññattikāmoti samaggā maṃ na sakkarissanti na garukarissanti na mānessanti na pūjessanti
an4.243:6.5: vaggā pana maṃ sakkarissanti garukarissanti mānessanti pūjessantīti
an4.243:6.6: idaṃ ānanda catutthaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṃghabhedena nandati.
an4.243:6.7: ime kho ānanda cattāro atthavase sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṃghabhedena nandatīti.
